mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the housing starts signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the industrial production signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a rate hike.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% over the previous 3 months, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the strong labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 5% and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% over the previous 3 months, it signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 5% and HOUST increase > 10% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the robust demand signal.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over the previous 6 months signals a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the GDP slowdown signal.
